verdict: CLOSE EXACT FINITE OPEN ALL-CUT B(H) UNITARIES AND CUT CCR, PLUS THE BALANCED-EVEN-M PERIODIC D-K-D AUTOMORPHISM AND NORMAL-STATE-TRANSPORT INTERTWINER; RETAIN FIXED WEYL-CSTAR INVARIANCE, STATIONARITY/SELECTION, INTER-REGULATOR, CONTINUUM/HADAMARD, 1D-TO-3D, C6, CP1, AND PRE-A GATES
statement: For the inserted one-dimensional CL8 D-K-D regulator, every admitted finite monotone history cut has an explicit non-product current-flux form and a global linear Darboux chart. A local valley flip is an exact nonlinear canonical map which factors into real-polynomial spectral-calculus phases, a neighbor-control shear and a central parity. This gives a genuine unitary on L2, preserves the Schwartz core, and induces an exact normal B(H) isomorphism. Ready incomparable flip unitaries commute exactly under a fixed spatial enumeration, so every finite open topological sweep is unitary and sweep independent. On the balanced even-M periodic seam the two checkerboard layers implement the already registered D-K-D history map projectively; their B(H) automorphisms and density transport agree exactly. Registered autonomous ground and Gibbs densities therefore define exact normal cut families and remain ground/Gibbs for an explicitly co-moving Hamiltonian, but are not shown stationary, selected, or ground/Gibbs for the unchanged inherited Hamiltonian. Raw A/B vertex algebras on neighboring legs do not commute because the spatial-current connector gives a nonzero cross commutator, so a per-raw-leg tensor factorization is formally rejected. The nonlinear circuit does not preserve one fixed concrete Weyl C-star algebra. Regulator compatibility, a physical reference, the 1D-to-3D parent and continuum/Hadamard limits remain open.

model_scope.selected_model: the explicitly inserted one-dimensional per-unit-transverse-area CL8 regulator with w=a/8 and the inherited nonlinear D-K-D step
model_scope.domain: finite open monotone cuts; and, for inherited periodic state/D-K-D comparison, M even with M>=4 on the balanced M/2 by M/2 seam; delta, c, chi, g, lambda and hbar nonzero with chi,c,g,lambda,hbar positive
model_scope.hilbert_dimension_boundary: the classical phase has finite real dimension 16M on the balanced seam, while H=L2(R^(8M)) is infinite-dimensional
model_scope.inserted_data: one-dimensional reduction, regulator, step delta, hbar, checkerboard interpretation, and any null, horizon or physical-time meaning remain inputs

history_quantum_step.discrete_Legendre_chart: q_n=x_n and pi_n=ell*(x_n-x_(n-1)); sum d pi_n wedge d q_n equals Omega_hist=ell sum dx_n wedge dx_(n-1)
history_quantum_step.type_one_phase: Phi(q_prime,q)=ell*||q_prime-q||^2/2-delta*U_a(q), with pi=-partial_q Phi and pi_prime=partial_q_prime Phi
history_quantum_step.mixed_Hessian: partial_q_prime partial_q Phi=-ell*I_(8M), so the finite-regulator kernel has no field-dependent caustic
history_quantum_step.unitary: U_hist=exp[-i*pi_hat^2/(2*ell*hbar)] exp[-i*delta*U_a(q_hat)/hbar], equivalently the oscillatory kernel with |c_ell|=(|ell|/(2*pi*hbar))^(4M), up to one global Fresnel phase fixed by the factor convention
history_quantum_step.DKD_relation: the half-drift metaplectic change gives U_hist=M_half U_DKD M_half^* exactly with the declared functional-calculus factors
history_quantum_step.core: the polynomial phases, free drift and their inverses preserve Schwartz space; displayed unbounded-generator identities are core identities

cut_Darboux_CCR.raw_edge: A_j=x_(n_j,j), B_j=x_(n_j+1,j), with adjacent cut heights differing by one
cut_Darboux_CCR.current_form: Omega_C=ell[sum_j dB_j wedge dA_j-kappa sum_(lower s adjacent to higher r) dB_s wedge dA_r]
cut_Darboux_CCR.Darboux_chart: Q_j=A_j and P_j=ell*(B_j-kappa*sum_(s adjacent and one history time lower than j) B_s), giving Omega_C=sum_j dP_j wedge dQ_j
cut_Darboux_CCR.global_inverse: P=ell*(I-kappa*N_C)B; N_C follows strictly increasing integer history time and is nilpotent on every admitted finite cut, so B=ell^(-1)*sum_r(kappa*N_C)^r P is finite and global
cut_Darboux_CCR.CCR: [Q_(j,e),P_(k,f)]=i*hbar*delta_jk*delta_ef in the regular Schrodinger representation; the represented cut Weyl system is irreducible and its von Neumann closure is B(H_C)
cut_Darboux_CCR.reference_regularity: on a checkerboard, the spatial connector cancels explicitly so high sites have Q=q and P=pi+ell*(1-2*kappa)q-delta*w*grad W_Q3(q), while low sites have Q=q-pi/ell and P=ell*q; a low-site metaplectic drift/chirp and a high-site position phase implement these operators, proving regularity and essential self-adjointness before Stone-von Neumann is invoked
cut_Darboux_CCR.periodic_boundary: on the balanced seam time is not periodically identified, the seam adjacency is counted once, and H_C=L2(R^(8M)); odd or time-shift seams are excluded

local_flip_unitary.canonical_map: at a valley s with retained neighbors L,R: Q_s_prime=-Q_s+kappa*(Q_L+Q_R)+f(P_s/ell), P_s_prime=-P_s+ell*f(Q_s_prime), P_L_prime=P_L+kappa*P_s, P_R_prime=P_R+kappa*P_s; retained Q and all other variables are unchanged
local_flip_unitary.factorization: with U^* Z U convention, U_flip=exp[-i*G_q(Q_s)/hbar] U_kappa R_s exp[-i*G_p(P_s)/hbar] implements the canonical map exactly; the induced point map is applied as four explicit right-to-left stages
local_flip_unitary.unitarity: each real polynomial of commuting positions or momenta is handled by joint spectral calculus; the control shear is metaplectic and all factors preserve Schwartz space
local_flip_unitary.not_Trotter: this is an exact finite product, not a Trotter or semiclassical approximation

all_cut_quantum_composition.fixed_enumeration: all cut Hilbert spaces use the same spatial-site ordering; explicit permutation intertwiners would otherwise be required
all_cut_quantum_composition.ready_commutation: simultaneously ready incomparable valleys have distinct centers; their generator Q/P support pairs are (empty,{s}), (N_s,{s}), and ({s},empty), with s not in N_t and t not in N_s, so every cross-pair strongly commutes even when retained Q controls overlap
all_cut_quantum_composition.sweep_independence: topological orders of a finite cell order ideal differ by adjacent swaps of incomparable ready cells; exact ready commutation makes the unitary product independent of sweep order
all_cut_quantum_composition.open_cut_scope: an open m by n cut has m+n+1 complete 16-real-dimensional A/B history legs, eight configuration coordinates per quantum factor, and H_C=L2(R^(8*(m+n+1))); all compared cuts keep this dimension
all_cut_quantum_composition.open_fixture: endpoint-aware exhaustive audits cover every cut and every saturated cell-addition sweep of the open 2 by 2 and 2 by 3 order ideals
all_cut_quantum_composition.periodic_scope: balanced endpoint identification removes one duplicate and leaves M complete history legs; this is the only scope compared with the inherited periodic H_a states

periodic_DKD_intertwiner.checkerboards: the two alternating cuts decode (x_(m-1),x_m), then (x_m,x_(m+1)), then (x_(m+1),x_(m+2))
periodic_DKD_intertwiner.typed_anchors: Lambda_C^[n]:H_C->H_hist is the explicit history decoder and Gamma_C^[n]=M_half^* Lambda_C^[n]:H_C->H_a is the phase anchor
periodic_DKD_intertwiner.implementers: for one checkerboard layer U_layer, Lambda_D^[n+1] U_layer=exp(i*theta_C) U_hist Lambda_C^[n] and equivalently Gamma_D^[n+1] U_layer=exp(i*theta_C) U_DKD Gamma_C^[n] because both sides have the same Heisenberg action on canonical generators
periodic_DKD_intertwiner.automorphisms: the scalar phase cancels, so the induced normal B(H) diagrams commute exactly
periodic_DKD_intertwiner.wavefunction_boundary: an exact implementer equality without the scalar would require an additional coherent metaplectic/Maslov phase convention
